title: Sasaki-Einstein rational homology spheres, rational varieties and the Berglund-Hübsch rule
summary: We find Sasaki-Einstein metrics on rational homology $(4n-1)$-spheres for $n>1$ built from cyclic polynomials of index 1 cutting out rational varieties. The Einstein metrics found here are inequivalent to the ones found by Boyer and Galicki in arXiv:math/0311355. Our findings are consequence of an improvement, for hypersurfaces defined by cycle polynomials, on the estimate given by Johnson and Kollár to determine Kähler-Einstein orbifold metrics.
